article.title: Prompted Brand在美國推出，把AI可見度工作與廣告審批放進同一平台
article.title_en: Prompted Brand announces US launch, combining AI visibility work and ad approvals
article.summary: 11月5日公告主打由AI答案產生待辦工作，ChatGPT廣告則經品牌自己的廣告帳戶處理。
article.summary_en: The November 5 release turns AI answers into work items and routes ChatGPT ads through a brand’s own advertiser account.
highlights: 待辦涵蓋內容缺口、引用網站、錯誤資料及爬蟲阻擋。
工作流程設人工批准；廣告另有每月上限及自動暫停。
highlights_en: Tasks cover content gaps, citation sites, wrong facts and crawler blocks.
Workflows pause for approval; ads have monthly caps and automatic pausing.
article.why: 品牌可把AI搜尋報告連到負責人及審批，並分開追蹤自然可見度與付費活動。
article.why_en: Brands can connect AI search reporting to owners and approvals while tracking organic visibility separately from paid activity.
article.next_step: 先查支援市場、語言及方案，再要求展示原始答案至待辦、審批及修訂紀錄的完整流程。
article.next_step_en: Check markets, languages and plans, then request a demonstration from raw answers to work items, approval and change history.
article.detail: 這是11月5日的美國推出公告；公司官方資料頁在10月29日已列出相關能力，因此不能把所有功能寫成當日首次出現。FactCheck按品牌提供的已核實資料檢查AI說法，資料本身仍需品牌維護。官方方案亦顯示各層級支援的引擎與功能不同。付費廣告不等於保證取得自然引用，本報亦未獨立驗證其可見度改善效果或香港帳戶適用性。
article.detail_en: This is a US launch announcement, not proof that every feature first appeared on November 5: the official facts page was updated October 29. Brand-supplied verified facts require upkeep, and features vary by plan. Paid placement does not guarantee organic citations or Hong Kong availability.
